title: Speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao Arrives
synopsis: Emperor Xian of Han escapes from Xi'an following the death of the famous villain Dong Zhuo. Can he make it back to Luoyang safely?

series.title: Famous Sayings and Stories from the Three Kingdoms

fullText.simplified:
说曹操，曹操到

    汉朝最后一个皇帝是汉献帝。汉献帝刚当皇帝的时候，国家被一个叫董卓的坏人控制着。董卓不但住在皇帝的皇宫里，而且还要求汉献帝和全国人都听他的话。董卓引起了大家的反对，全国各地的军队一起来到首都洛阳打董卓。董卓被打败了，他往另一个城市跑。离开前，他不但放火烧了洛阳城和皇宫，而且还把汉献帝抓走了。
    董卓带着汉献帝来到了西安。过了一段时间，董卓死了。汉献帝找到机会，带着身边的一些人，从西安跑了出来。不过，董卓虽然死了，但他下面还有不少人。这些人都想当第二个“董卓”。他们发现汉献帝不见了以后，马上出来找他，想把他抓回去。
    汉献帝想回洛阳，就往洛阳的方向跑。一路上辛苦极了。马车又破又小，吃的东西也很少。有人生病，有人死了，汉献帝的人越来越少。但董卓的人就跟在后面，汉献帝不敢休息，再辛苦也只能往前走。
    一天，大家都走不动了。有人对汉献帝说：“听说曹操在山东发展得不错，我们能请他来接您吗？”当时全国各地的军队都很乱，能来帮汉献帝的人不多。汉献帝知道曹操，他觉得曹操应该能帮自己，于是马上让使者去山东见曹操。
    使者离开后不久，董卓的人就找到了汉献帝，他们的人非常多。汉献帝难过地说：“去见曹操的使者还没有回来，我就要被抓住了。”
    但没想到，他的话刚说完，曹操就带着军队赶到了。原来，虽然汉献帝的使者还没有见到曹操，但曹操在山东听说了汉献帝的情况，就自己带着军队赶来帮忙了。曹操把董卓的人赶走了，汉献帝安全了。
    人们根据这件事情，总结了“说曹操，曹操到”这句俗语。它的意思是，正在说一个人的时候，这个人突然出现了，很多时候有惊喜的意思。
    生活中，我们也可以说这句话。比如：你和朋友A要去看电影，你们想问朋友B要不要一起去。你们刚准备打电话给他，这时候，他突然来了，你就可以高兴地说一句：“真是说曹操，曹操到！我们刚想找你呢！”
fullText.traditional:
說曹操，曹操到

    漢朝最後一個皇帝是漢獻帝。漢獻帝剛當皇帝的時候，國家被一個叫董卓的壞人控制著。董卓不但住在皇帝的皇宮裡，而且還要求漢獻帝和全國人都聽他的話。董卓引起了大家的反對，全國各地的軍隊一起來到首都洛陽打董卓。董卓被打敗了，他往另一個城市跑。離開前，他不但放火燒了洛陽城和皇宮，而且還把漢獻帝抓走了。
    董卓帶著漢獻帝來到了西安。過了一段時間，董卓死了。漢獻帝找到機會，帶著身邊的一些人，從西安跑了出來。不過，董卓雖然死了，但他下面還有不少人。這些人都想當第二個“董卓”。他們發現漢獻帝不見了以後，馬上出來找他，想把他抓回去。
    漢獻帝想回洛陽，就往洛陽的方向跑。一路上辛苦極了。馬車又破又小，吃的東西也很少。有人生病，有人死了，漢獻帝的人越來越少。但董卓的人就跟在後面，漢獻帝不敢休息，再辛苦也只能往前走。
    一天，大家都走不動了。有人對漢獻帝說：“聽說曹操在山東發展得不錯，我們能請他來接您嗎？”當時全國各地的軍隊都很亂，能來幫漢獻帝的人不多。漢獻帝知道曹操，他覺得曹操應該能幫自己，於是馬上讓使者去山東見曹操。
    使者離開後不久，董卓的人就找到了漢獻帝，他們的人非常多。漢獻帝難過地說：“去見曹操的使者還沒有回來，我就要被抓住了。”
    但沒想到，他的話剛說完，曹操就帶著軍隊趕到了。原來，雖然漢獻帝的使者還沒有見到曹操，但曹操在山東聽說了漢獻帝的情況，就自己帶著軍隊趕來幫忙了。曹操把董卓的人趕走了，漢獻帝安全了。
    人們根據這件事情，總結了“說曹操，曹操到”這句俗語。它的意思是，正在說一個人的時候，這個人突然出現了，很多時候有驚喜的意思。
    生活中，我們也可以說這句話。比如：你和朋友A要去看電影，你們想問朋友B要不要一起去。你們剛準備打電話給他，這時候，他突然來了，你就可以高興地說一句：“真是說曹操，曹操到！我們剛想找你呢！”

sentences.simplified: 汉朝最后一个皇帝是汉献帝。
sentences.traditional: 漢朝最後一個皇帝是漢獻帝。
sentences.pinyin: hàn cháo zuì hòu yí ge huáng dì shì hàn xiàn dì
sentences.english: The last emperor of the Han Dynasty was Emperor Xian of Han.

sentences.simplified: 汉献帝刚当皇帝的时候，国家被一个叫董卓的坏人控制着。
sentences.traditional: 漢獻帝剛當皇帝的時候，國家被一個叫董卓的壞人控制著。
sentences.pinyin: hàn xiàn dì gāng dāng huáng dì de shí hou guó jiā bèi yí ge jiào dǒng zhuó de huài rén kòng zhì zhe
sentences.english: When Emperor Xian of Han had just ascended the throne, the country was under the control of a wicked man named Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 董卓不但住在皇帝的皇宫里，而且还要求汉献帝和全国人都听他的话。
sentences.traditional: 董卓不但住在皇帝的皇宮裡，而且還要求漢獻帝和全國人都聽他的話。
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó bú dàn zhù zài huáng dì de huáng gōng lǐ ér qiě hái yāo qiú hàn xiàn dì hé quán guó rén dōu tīng tā de huà
sentences.english: Not only did Dong Zhuo live in the emperor’s palace, but he also demanded that Emperor Xian of Han and everyone in the country obey him.

sentences.simplified: 董卓引起了大家的反对，全国各地的军队一起来到首都洛阳打董卓。
sentences.traditional: 董卓引起了大家的反對，全國各地的軍隊一起來到首都洛陽打董卓。
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó yǐn qǐ le dà jiā de fǎn duì quán guó gè dì de jūn duì yì qǐ lái dào shǒu dū luò yáng dǎ dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo drew opposition from everyone. Armies from across the country came to the capital city of Luoyang to fight Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 董卓被打败了，他往另一个城市跑。
sentences.traditional: 董卓被打敗了，他往另一個城市跑。
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó bèi dǎ bài le tā wǎng lìng yī ge chéng shì pǎo
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo was defeated, and he fled to another city.

sentences.simplified: 离开前，他不但放火烧了洛阳城和皇宫，
sentences.traditional: 離開前，他不但放火燒了洛陽城和皇宮，
sentences.pinyin: lí kāi qián tā bú dàn fàng huǒ shāo le luò yáng chéng hé huáng gōng
sentences.english: Before leaving, he not only set fire to the city of Luoyang and the imperial palace ..

sentences.simplified: 而且还把汉献帝抓走了。
sentences.traditional: 而且還把漢獻帝抓走了。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě hái bǎ hàn xiàn dì zhuā zǒu le
sentences.english: .. but also captured Emperor Xian of Han and took him with him.

sentences.simplified: 董卓带着汉献帝来到了西安。
sentences.traditional: 董卓帶著漢獻帝來到了西安。
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó dài zhe hàn xiàn dì lái dào le xī ān
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo brought Emperor Xian of Han to Xi’an.

sentences.simplified: 过了一段时间，董卓死了。汉献帝找到机会，带着身边的一些人，从西安跑了出来。
sentences.traditional: 過了一段時間，董卓死了。漢獻帝找到機會，帶著身邊的一些人，從西安跑了出來。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí duàn shí jiān dǒng zhuó sǐ le hàn xiàn dì zhǎo dào jī huì dài zhe shēn biān de yì xiē rén cóng xī ān pǎo le chū lái
sentences.english: Some time later, Dong Zhuo died. Seizing the opportunity, Emperor Xian of Han escaped from Xi’an with a few of his men.

sentences.simplified: 不过，董卓虽然死了，但他下面还有不少人。
sentences.traditional: 不過，董卓雖然死了，但他下面還有不少人。
sentences.pinyin: bú guò dǒng zhuó suī rán sǐ le dàn tā xià miàn hái yǒu bù shǎo rén
sentences.english: However, although Dong Zhuo was dead, he still had many men under him.

sentences.simplified: 这些人都想当第二个“董卓”。
sentences.traditional: 這些人都想當第二個“董卓”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē rén dōu xiǎng dāng dì èr ge dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: All of these people wanted to become the next “Dong Zhuo”.

sentences.simplified: 他们发现汉献帝不见了以后，马上出来找他，想把他抓回去。
sentences.traditional: 他們發現漢獻帝不見了以後，馬上出來找他，想把他抓回去。
sentences.pinyin: tā men fā xiàn hàn xiàn dì bú jiàn le yǐ hòu mǎ shàng chū lái zhǎo tā xiǎng bǎ tā zhuā huí qu
sentences.english: When they discovered that Emperor Xian was missing, they immediately set out to look for him, intending to capture him and bring him back.

sentences.simplified: 汉献帝想回洛阳，就往洛阳的方向跑。一路上辛苦极了。
sentences.traditional: 漢獻帝想回洛陽，就往洛陽的方向跑。一路上辛苦極了。
sentences.pinyin: hàn xiàn dì xiǎng huí luò yáng jiù wǎng luò yáng de fāng xiàng pǎo yí lù shang xīn kǔ jí le
sentences.english: Emperor Xian of Han wanted to return to Luoyang, so he fled in that direction. The journey was extremely difficult.

sentences.simplified: 马车又破又小，吃的东西也很少。
sentences.traditional: 馬車又破又小，吃的東西也很少。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ chē yòu pò yòu xiǎo chī de dōng xi yě hěn shǎo
sentences.english: The carriage was shabby and small, and there was very little food.

sentences.simplified: 有人生病，有人死了，汉献帝的人越来越少。
sentences.traditional: 有人生病，有人死了，漢獻帝的人越來越少。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén shēng bìng yǒu rén sǐ le hàn xiàn dì de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo
sentences.english: Some people fell ill, and some people died. Emperor Xian of Han had fewer and fewer men.

sentences.simplified: 但董卓的人就跟在后面，
sentences.traditional: 但董卓的人就跟在後面，
sentences.pinyin: dàn dǒng zhuó de rén jiù gēn zài hòu miàn
sentences.english: But Dong Zhuo’s men were right behind them.

sentences.simplified: 汉献帝不敢休息，再辛苦也只能往前走。
sentences.traditional: 漢獻帝不敢休息，再辛苦也只能往前走。
sentences.pinyin: hàn xiàn dì bù gǎn xiū xi zài xīn kǔ yě zhǐ néng wǎng qián zǒu
sentences.english: Emperor Xian of Han didn’t dare to rest. No matter how exhausting it was, he had to keep going forward.

sentences.simplified: 一天，大家都走不动了。
sentences.traditional: 一天，大家都走不動了。
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān dà jiā dōu zǒu bú dòng le
sentences.english: One day, they were unable to go on.

sentences.simplified: 有人对汉献帝说：“听说曹操在山东发展得不错，我们能请他来接您吗？”
sentences.traditional: 有人對漢獻帝說：“聽說曹操在山東發展得不錯，我們能請他來接您嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén duì hàn xiàn dì shuō tīng shuō cáo cāo zài shān dōng fā zhǎn de bú cuò wǒ men néng qǐng tā lái jiē nín ma
sentences.english: Someone said to Emperor Xian of Han, “I‘ve heard that Cao Cao is doing well in Shandong. Can we ask him to come and escort you?”

sentences.simplified: 当时全国各地的军队都很乱，能来帮汉献帝的人不多。
sentences.traditional: 當時全國各地的軍隊都很亂，能來幫漢獻帝的人不多。
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí quán guó gè dì de jūn duì dōu hěn luàn néng lái bāng hàn xiàn dì de rén bù duō
sentences.english: At that time, the armies across the country were in chaos, and there were few who could come to help Emperor Xian of Han.

sentences.simplified: 汉献帝知道曹操，
sentences.traditional: 漢獻帝知道曹操，
sentences.pinyin: hàn xiàn dì zhī dào cáo cāo
sentences.english: Emperor Xian of Han knew Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 他觉得曹操应该能帮自己，于是马上让使者去山东见曹操。
sentences.traditional: 他覺得曹操應該能幫自己，於是馬上讓使者去山東見曹操。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de cáo cāo yīng gāi néng bāng zì jǐ yú shì mǎ shàng ràng shǐ zhě qù shān dōng jiàn cáo cāo
sentences.english: He thought that Cao Cao would be able to help him, so he immediately sent an envoy to Shandong to meet Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 使者离开后不久，董卓的人就找到了汉献帝，他们的人非常多。
sentences.traditional: 使者離開後不久，董卓的人就找到了漢獻帝，他們的人非常多。
sentences.pinyin: shǐ zhě lí kāi hòu bù jiǔ dǒng zhuó de rén jiù zhǎo dào le hàn xiàn dì tā men de rén fēi cháng duō
sentences.english: Shortly after the envoy left, Dong Zhuo’s men found Emperor Xian of Han, and there were many of them.

sentences.simplified: 汉献帝难过地说：“去见曹操的使者还没有回来，我就要被抓住了。”
sentences.traditional: 漢獻帝難過地說：“去見曹操的使者還沒有回來，我就要被抓住了。”

sentences.english: Emperor Xian said sadly, “The envoy I sent to see Cao Cao hasn’t returned yet, and now I’m about to be captured.”

sentences.simplified: 但没想到，他的话刚说完，曹操就带着军队赶到了。
sentences.traditional: 但沒想到，他的話剛說完，曹操就帶著軍隊趕到了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn méi xiǎng dào tā de huà gāng shuō wán cáo cāo jiù dài zhe jūn duì gǎn dào le
sentences.english: But unexpectedly, just as he finished speaking, Cao Cao arrived with his army.

sentences.simplified: 原来，虽然汉献帝的使者还没有见到曹操，
sentences.traditional: 原來，雖然漢獻帝的使者還沒有見到曹操，
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái suī rán hàn xiàn dì de shǐ zhě hái méi yǒu jiàn dào cáo cāo
sentences.english: It turned out that although the envoy of Emperor Xian of Han had not yet met Cao Cao, ..

sentences.traditional: 但曹操在山東聽說了漢獻帝的情況，就自己帶著軍隊趕來幫忙了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn cáo cāo zài shān dōng tīng shuō le hàn xiàn dì de qíng kuàng jiù zì jǐ dài zhe jūn duì gǎn lái bāng máng le
sentences.english: .. but Cao Cao had heard about Emperor Xian’s situation while in Shandong and brought his army over to help.

sentences.simplified: 曹操把董卓的人赶走了，汉献帝安全了。
sentences.traditional: 曹操把董卓的人趕走了，漢獻帝安全了。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo bǎ dǒng zhuó de rén gǎn zǒu le hàn xiàn dì ān quán le
sentences.english: Cao Cao drove Dong Zhuo’s men away, and Emperor Xian of Han was safe.

sentences.english: People summed up this event with the saying “Speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao arrives”.

sentences.english: It means that when you’re talking about someone, that person suddenly appears, often bringing a sense of surprise.

sentence_translations: Speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao Arrives
The last emperor of the Han Dynasty was Emperor Xian of Han.
When Emperor Xian of Han had just ascended the throne, the country was under the control of a wicked man named Dong Zhuo.
Not only did Dong Zhuo live in the emperor’s palace, but he also demanded that Emperor Xian of Han and everyone in the country obey him.
Dong Zhuo drew opposition from everyone. Armies from across the country came to the capital city of Luoyang to fight Dong Zhuo.
Dong Zhuo was defeated, and he fled to another city.
Before leaving, he not only set fire to the city of Luoyang and the imperial palace ..
.. but also captured Emperor Xian of Han and took him with him.
Dong Zhuo brought Emperor Xian of Han to Xi’an.
Some time later, Dong Zhuo died. Seizing the opportunity, Emperor Xian of Han escaped from Xi’an with a few of his men.
However, although Dong Zhuo was dead, he still had many men under him.
All of these people wanted to become the next “Dong Zhuo”.
When they discovered that Emperor Xian was missing, they immediately set out to look for him, intending to capture him and bring him back.
Emperor Xian of Han wanted to return to Luoyang, so he fled in that direction. The journey was extremely difficult.
The carriage was shabby and small, and there was very little food.
Some people fell ill, and some people died. Emperor Xian of Han had fewer and fewer men.
But Dong Zhuo’s men were right behind them.
Emperor Xian of Han didn’t dare to rest. No matter how exhausting it was, he had to keep going forward.
One day, they were unable to go on.
Someone said to Emperor Xian of Han, “I‘ve heard that Cao Cao is doing well in Shandong. Can we ask him to come and escort you?”
At that time, the armies across the country were in chaos, and there were few who could come to help Emperor Xian of Han.
Emperor Xian of Han knew Cao Cao.
He thought that Cao Cao would be able to help him, so he immediately sent an envoy to Shandong to meet Cao Cao.
Shortly after the envoy left, Dong Zhuo’s men found Emperor Xian of Han, and there were many of them.
Emperor Xian said sadly, “The envoy I sent to see Cao Cao hasn’t returned yet, and now I’m about to be captured.”
But unexpectedly, just as he finished speaking, Cao Cao arrived with his army.
It turned out that although the envoy of Emperor Xian of Han had not yet met Cao Cao, ..
.. but Cao Cao had heard about Emperor Xian’s situation while in Shandong and brought his army over to help.
Cao Cao drove Dong Zhuo’s men away, and Emperor Xian of Han was safe.
People summed up this event with the saying “Speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao arrives”.
It means that when you’re talking about someone, that person suddenly appears, often bringing a sense of surprise.
In everyday life, we can also use this saying.
For example, you and your friend A are going to see a movie, and you want to ask your friend B if they want to join you.
You’re just about to call them when they suddenly show up.
You can happily say, “Speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao arrives! We were just about to call you!”
